shorts.description:
Surstromming — fermented herring from Sweden, and the smelliest food on Earth. Scientifically. The cans literally BULGE from the gas building up inside, and one study measured it as one of the most putrid food odors ever recorded. Open one indoors and the smell can clear a whole building — it's been BANNED on airplanes. Banned. On airplanes. Your lunch is legally a biohazard at thirty thousand feet.

Brave Swedes eat it outdoors with flatbread, potatoes, and onions — always in August, always upwind. Tourists film themselves opening cans: instant regret, every single time.

Would YOU try it? Tell me in the comments!

shorts.description:
NUMBER ONE. The undisputed champion of weird food: Casu Marzu. From the island of Sardinia, Italy — the name literally means... rotten cheese.

It starts as normal sheep's milk cheese. Then they introduce cheese fly larvae — thousands of them. The maggots digest the cheese from the inside until it turns soft and gooey. And when served? The maggots are still alive. Wriggling. In your food. Right now.

Some say the maggots MUST be alive when you eat it — dead maggots mean the cheese has gone bad. The European Union officially BANNED it as a health hazard... and Sardinians eat it at weddings anyway. At WEDDINGS, people! I cannot make this up!

Weirdness Score: a perfect TEN out of ten. Casu Marzu is the weirdest food on planet Earth.

Which one would YOU actually try? Be honest!

shorts.description:
Kopi Luwak — the most expensive coffee on Earth. Made from... poop.

In Indonesia, a cat-like animal called the civet eats ripe coffee cherries... and poops out the beans. Farmers collect the beans from the droppings, wash them, roast them — and sell them for hundreds of dollars per kilo. One cup in a fancy cafe can cost more than your whole lunch for a week. For poop coffee!

Fans say digestion makes it smoother and less bitter. Critics say you're just drinking... expensive poop. The ugly truth? Most kopi luwak today comes from caged civets in rough conditions. So it's weird AND sad.

Weirdness Score: eight out of ten. Paying six hundred dollars for poop coffee is a CHOICE.

Would YOU drink it? Comment below!
